about: Place names the player is told (ink UI round, gen/ui/STYLE.md 'Place notifications'). region: the large banner shown when you walk into this section's region (sections sharing a region id show it once). landmarks: a vertical name plaque stands over the map entity id as you approach (江南百景圖's plaques), and a toast with the line from the painting's reading when you come within r metres of its footprint (or its point); top: the plaque's height when the map has none. Every name and line in 繁體, from the painting and its readings; src says where. Lore (round 2, gen/ui/r2_lore.md): long is the longer description under the toast's fold and in the 圖志 journal; quote and quoteSrc an exact line from a period or scholarly source; cite the sources as the player reads them; longSrc one note per claim (never shown); crop the map IDs that frame the painting's crop (tools/place_crops.mjs). Bundled for the page by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/places.json (short) and lore.json (long, fetched when needed). Every displayed field has an English sibling `<field>_en`, shown as a gloss under the Chinese when the viewer picks 中英 (Chinese stays the default).

region.name: 汴河
region.src: map/sections.json S2 '汴河 · 运河两岸'; 余辉《深度游》第二段 运河两岸
region.long: 過了城鄉交界，汴河流進畫面。這條運河自洛口引黃河水，東流入淮，東南的糧米貨物都由它運進京城。宋太宗說過，京城「養兵數十萬，居人百萬家」，全仰這一渠水。岸邊泊著吃水很深的糧船，腳夫扛著糧袋上岸，船主坐在貨包上歇息；沿河一條街多是飯館茶肆，臨河的雅座開窗對著水面。高處一座望火樓卻空無一人，余輝讀作繁華底下的隱憂。
region.long_en: Past the line where town meets country, the Bian Canal flows into the picture. It draws Yellow River water at Luokou and runs east to the Huai, and the grain and goods of the south-east come into the capital along it. Emperor Taizong of Song said the capital, which “keeps hundreds of thousands of soldiers and a million households,” depended wholly on this one channel. Deep-laden grain boats are moored along the bank, porters carry sacks ashore, and a boat-owner rests on his bundles; the street along the water is mostly eating houses and teahouses, their riverside seats opening windows onto the water. A fire-watch tower on high ground stands empty, which Yu Hui reads as a worry hidden beneath the prosperity.
region.quote: 運東南之糧，凡東南方物，自此入京城，公私仰給焉。
region.quote_en: Bringing in the grain of the south-east: all the goods of the south-east enter the capital this way, and public and private households alike depend on it.
region.cite: 《東京夢華錄》・故宮名畫記・余輝〈十大看點〉
region.cite_en: Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital · Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Yu Hui, Ten Highlights
longSrc: DJ 卷一 河道: 汴河自西京洛口分水入京城，东去至泗州，入淮
MHJ 7: 汴河之水来自于黄河; 宋太宗 "东京养兵数十万，居人百万家，天下转漕仰给，在此一渠水"
MHJ 8 万石船 (two heavy-laden boats moored); MHJ 9 仓前成市 (porters unloading sacks, the owner sits on the bales)
MHJ 10, 14: the riverside street, mostly eateries; 沿河雅座 windows open to the river
YH15 看点二 虚设的望火楼: 楼上无一人守望

landmarks.name: 沿河雅座
landmarks.line: 臨河的飯館，開窗看汴水。
landmarks.line_en: A restaurant on the bank, windows open to the Bian waters.
landmarks.long: 從河邊停泊的船隻看，這裏是個大碼頭。臨河一座長廳架在岸上，一排大窗全敞著，窗裏擺著長桌和交腳的坐具，西頭窗下坐著一位客人，身旁還有個小些的人影。故宮名畫記說，客人在這裏一邊飲酒，一邊看河上風景；乘船來的客人，興許也會拉著船主上岸喝兩杯。長廳東頭同一道屋頂下，是一座門扇緊閉的倉房。
landmarks.long_en: Judging by the boats moored along the bank, this is a big wharf. A long hall stands on the shore beside the water with a row of wide windows thrown open; inside are long tables and folding stools, and a guest sits at the west window with a smaller figure beside him. The Palace Museum's notes say the guest is drinking while he watches the river, and that travellers arriving by boat might also pull the boatman ashore for a cup or two. At the east end of the hall, under the same roof, is a storehouse with its doors shut tight.
landmarks.cite: 故宮名畫記・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · What the painting shows
longSrc: MHJ 14: 从停泊的船只数量上看，这里是一个大码头…有窗户敞开正对着河面，客人一边喝酒，一边欣赏风景。乘船的客人，兴许会拉着船主，去岸上喝两杯

landmarks.name: 王家紙馬
landmarks.line: 清明上墳的紙馬，都在這裏買。
landmarks.line_en: Paper horses for Qingming graves are all bought here.
landmarks.src: 名画记 13 王家纸马铺 (the painted sign 王家纸马); 余辉 2023 列售纸码
landmarks.long: 丁字路口有一家專賣紙紮冥器的鋪子，門前立著高高的招牌，學者讀作「王家紙馬」；鋪前一座木架，紙錢紙馬一直疊到屋簷。故宮名畫記說，宋人不像唐人那樣厚葬，多用紙做的錢和冥器代替實物，這風俗一直流傳到今天。招牌前，一位戴著高帽兜的人騎驢停下，正朝鋪子張望。
landmarks.long_en: At a T-junction stands a shop that sells nothing but paper offerings for the dead, with a tall sign out front that scholars read as “Wang Family Paper Horses.” In front is a wooden frame with paper money and paper horses piled up to the eaves. The Palace Museum's notes say the Song, unlike the Tang, did not bury the dead with lavish goods but used paper money and paper models in place of the real things, a custom that has lasted to this day. In front of the sign, a rider in a tall hood has stopped his donkey and is looking toward the shop.
landmarks.quote: 紙馬鋪皆於當街用紙袞疊成樓閣之狀。
landmarks.quote_en: The paper-horse shops all pile up paper into the shape of towers and pavilions right in the street.
landmarks.cite: 故宮名畫記・《東京夢華錄》・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital · What the painting shows
longSrc: MHJ 13: 丁字路口有一家专门卖冥器的纸马铺…宋人…主张薄葬，多以纸做的钱和冥器代替实物冥器，这种风俗影响至今

landmarks.name: 望火樓
landmarks.line: 樓上本該有人瞭望，如今空著。
landmarks.line_en: Someone should be up there keeping watch. No one is.
landmarks.src: 《东京梦华录》卷三 防火 '于高处砖砌望火楼，楼上有人卓望'; 余辉: the empty lookout (盛世危图 reading)
landmarks.long: 磚砌的高臺上一座小亭，一道木梯從西邊攀上臺頂。照《東京夢華錄》，京城的望火樓樓上該有人瞭望，樓下駐著兵士，備著水桶、麻搭、梯子，一見火起便奔報撲救。畫中這座卻空無一人，余輝說臺上原本的高柱被截去大半，改成了供人歇息的涼亭，樓下兩排營房也做了飯鋪。他把這裏讀作「虛設的望火樓」。
landmarks.long_en: On a high brick platform stands a small pavilion, with a wooden ladder climbing the platform from the west. According to Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital, a capital fire-watch tower should have a lookout above and soldiers below, with buckets, fire-swabs and ladders ready to run to a fire the moment it is seen. The one in the painting is empty: Yu Hui says the tall posts that once stood on the platform were mostly cut away and turned into a cool pavilion for resting, and the two rows of barracks below became eating shops. He reads it as a “fire tower in name only.”
landmarks.quote: 於高處磚砌望火樓，樓上有人卓望。
landmarks.quote_en: On high ground, a fire-watch tower of brick, with men on top keeping a lookout.
landmarks.cite: 《東京夢華錄》・余輝〈十大看點〉〈最後三問〉・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital · Yu Hui, Ten Highlights and The Last Three Questions · What the painting shows
longSrc: map S2.str.fire_tower_platform_28450 (brick platform, wooden stair from the west, nobody on it); S2.bld.fire_tower_28440 (nobody in it)
DJ 卷三 防火: 下有官屋数间，屯驻军兵…救火家事，谓如大小桶、洒子、麻搭、斧锯、梯子…每遇有遗火去处，则有马军奔报
YH21: 砖台上原本立了四个高高的柱子…眼下四根木柱被截去大半，支撑的却是凉亭…其下的两排营房变成了饭铺
YH15 看点二 虚设的望火楼

landmarks.name: 望樓飯鋪
landmarks.name_en: The Eating Shops by the Tower
landmarks.line_en: The eating shops beneath the fire tower.
landmarks.src: 余辉 2014 vignette 望楼饭铺
landmarks.long: 望火樓下一長排草頂棚屋，柱子底下擺滿桌凳，坐著吃喝的客人。余輝以為，這本是望火樓下兵營式的平房，如今改成了飯館。這一帶正是城鄉交界，碼頭對著一條沿河小街，店鋪多賣小吃。故宮名畫記寫街口一景：兩個過路客人卸下驢背上的行李歇腳，店主坐在涼棚下休息，大家的目光都被鄰家小孩的哭聲引了過去。
landmarks.long_en: Beneath the fire tower runs a long row of thatched sheds, with tables and benches set out under the posts and customers eating and drinking. Yu Hui believes these were once barracks-style single-storey buildings under the fire tower, now turned into restaurants. This is where town meets country, a wharf facing a small riverside street, and most shops sell snacks. The Palace Museum's notes describe a scene at the corner of the street: two passing travellers have unloaded the baggage from their donkeys to rest, the shopkeeper sits under his awning, and everyone's eyes are drawn by a neighbour's child crying.
landmarks.cite: 余輝〈十大看點〉・故宮名畫記・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Yu Hui, Ten Highlights · Palace Museum, Minghuaji · What the painting shows
longSrc: map S2.bld.wanglou_shed_28660: long open eating shed under thatch, tables, benches, seated customers
YH15 看点二: 望火楼下两排兵营式的平房已被改作饭馆
MHJ 10 城乡交界处: 沿河街…主要店铺是餐馆，以小吃为多…两个过路的客人正在歇脚，行李也从驴身上卸下来…店主坐在凉棚底下歇息…被邻居家小孩的哭声所吸引
